name: com.wultra.mtokentest
description: A sample Cordova application that runs Mobile Token Tests.

scripts.reinstallPlugin: (npx cordova plugin remove cordova-mtoken-sdk || true) && npm run rebuildPlugin && npm run installPlugin
scripts.buildAndroid: npm run build && cordova build android
scripts.freshAndroid: npm run reinstallPlugin && npm run buildAndroid && npm run android
scripts.buildIos: npm run build && cordova build ios
scripts.freshIos: npm run reinstallPlugin && npm run buildIos && npm run ios

author: Apache Cordova Team
